providers.label: Anthropic
providers.free_tier: none — paid from the first token
providers.notes: Own message schema, hence its own adapter.

providers.label: NVIDIA NIM (build.nvidia.com)
providers.free_tier: ~1000 credits with the free Developer Program, no card, ~40 RPM
providers.notes: OpenAI-compatible, so it costs no extra adapter. Verify the credit figure on NVIDIA's own pricing page before depending on it.

providers.label: OpenRouter
providers.free_tier: the :free model suffix routes to a rate-limited free pool — check openrouter.ai/minimax/minimax-m3 for current limits
providers.notes: context_tokens is the schema default, not a measured figure for this specific model — check the model's own OpenRouter page and correct it here if it differs. Single endpoint fronting many providers/models; change default_model to point at a different one.

providers.label: Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint
providers.notes: Set base_url and default_model when selecting this. Covers OpenRouter, Groq, DeepSeek, Together, or a llama.cpp server on another machine.
